label: IGH / CCND1

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
CCND1 encodes cyclin D1, a regulator of CDK4/6-dependent cell-cycle progression.

The t(11;14) rearrangement increases cyclin D1 expression through IGH regulatory control and promotes cell-cycle progression. It is characteristic of mantle cell lymphoma and also defines a major plasma cell myeloma subgroup.
